barras.mundo_sin_hambre: There's no hunger or thirst in this world, so there are no bars to show.
barras.rescate_ok: Your hunger and thirst bars weren't loaded, so I just created them. If you still can't see them, tell an admin.
barras.rescate_fallo: I couldn't create your hunger and thirst bars. Tell an admin: it's recorded in the server log.
version.solo_creativo: This command only works in Creative mode.
nivel.sin_hambre: Couldn't find the player's hunger component.
nivel.sin_sed: Couldn't find the player's thirst component.
nivel.sin_jugador: Couldn't find that player, or they're not in a world.
addall.valor_invalido: The value must be greater than 0 (got <v>{valor}</v>).
addall.revisando: Checking every item on the server for food and drinks...
rango.hud_estilo: HudEstilo must be ANILLOS or BARRAS (got {valor})
panel.inventario: YOUR INVENTORY (click to fill Item ID)
panel.id_vacio: The item ID can't be empty.
panel.valor_no_numero: That value isn't a valid number.
tip.max_hunger: Maximum hunger level the player can have.
tip.starvation_per_tick: Amount of hunger lost per tick.
tip.starvation_damage: Damage taken when hunger reaches zero.
tip.hungry_threshold: Hunger level where warnings start appearing.
tip.max_thirst: Maximum thirst level the player can have.
tip.thirst_decay_rate: Amount of thirst lost per tick.
tip.sprint_thirst_multiplier: Multiplier applied to thirst decay when sprinting.
tip.thirst_damage: Damage taken when thirst reaches zero.
tip.thirsty_threshold: Thirst level where warnings start appearing.
tip.starvation_stamina_modifier: How much stamina depletion affects hunger decay.
tip.well_fed_enabled: Enable regen buffs (Nourished / Hydrated) when food/water is high.
tip.well_fed_threshold: Hunger/thirst level required to activate regen buffs.
tip.pause_while_sleeping: Pause hunger/thirst while the player is in bed.
tip.idle_pause_seconds: Time in seconds to wait before pausing decay.
tip.hud_estilo: ANILLOS: two rings right of the hotbar, mirroring the Z slot. BARRAS: above health and stamina. Applies on reconnect.
tip.hud_offset_y: Shift the rings or bars up (+) or down (-) by this many pixels.
tip.hud_init_delay_ms: Delay before sending the HUD after join. 0 = immediately. Raise if bars sometimes fail to appear on join.
tip.disabled_worlds: Worlds where the mod does nothing. Separate with commas. A trailing * is a wildcard: instance-Hauldron* covers every Hauldron dungeon. Empty = active everywhere.
